scholarships.title: Cranfield University GREAT Scholarship 2026 Bangladesh
scholarships.official_source: Cranfield University, in partnership with the British Council

existing.description: Bursary Enhanced Learning Credit (ELC) Scheme The Ministry of Defence provides financial support for members of the Armed Forces to undertake award bearing courses
eligibility: Passport holder and resident in Bangladesh
Has made an application for admission to the course and received a six digit Cranfield student ID
Chosen course is one of the listed eligible full-time MSc programmes
Chosen course starts in September or October of the award year
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to applicants who are Bangladeshi passport holders resident in Bangladesh, have already applied for admission to an eligible full-time postgraduate master's course at Cranfield and hold a six digit student ID, and submit the online scholarship form answering four written questions. The chosen course must start in September or October of the award year.
benefits: Access to the British Council GREAT Scholarships alumni network
requirements: Applicants should be passport holders and resident in Bangladesh.
Applications may be unsuccessful for a number of reasons. Sometimes there are more applications than places on a particular course, or an application may not meet the standard entry requirements.
We don’t routinely provide feedback to applicants on the reasons for our decisions. If you wish to request feedback on an unsuccessful application, please email our Admissions Office .
documents: Completed online scholarship application form with all four written answers
application_method: Apply for admission to an eligible Cranfield full-time MSc course
Wait until you have received your six digit Cranfield student ID
Submit the online scholarship application using the Apply Now link on the scholarship page
Answer all four questions, each between 250 and 1000 characters
existing.selection_notes: Cranfield asks applicants to describe their motivation for choosing Cranfield and their course, the significance of the GREAT Scholarship to their career, evidence of leadership experience and potential, and how they will act as an advocate for Cranfield and the GREAT Scholarship campaign. Applicants may include academic achievement to demonstrate communication ability.
existing.duration: One year; single award applied toward tuition fees for a one-year full-time master's course
existing.application_period: For courses starting September or October 2026. Applications closed at 5pm on Monday 18 May 2026 and all applicants were to be notified by the end of June 2026. Cranfield has not published dates for the next annual cycle.

existing.program_type: Partial tuition fee scholarship under the British Council GREAT Scholarships campaign

scholarships.official_source: The University of Edinburgh, in partnership with the British Council

eligibility: National and resident of Thailand, Mexico or Ghana
Accepted for admission on a full-time basis for an eligible one-year, on-campus postgraduate master's programme at the University of Edinburgh
Holds, or expects to obtain, the overseas equivalent of a UK first-class honours degree
Willing to give written consent to be contacted by the British Council for pre-departure briefings, programme reporting, evaluation and promotion
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to nationals and residents of Thailand, Mexico or Ghana who are accepted for admission on a full-time basis to an eligible one-year, on-campus postgraduate master's programme at the University of Edinburgh, and who hold or expect the overseas equivalent of a UK first-class honours degree. Bangladesh is not an eligible country for the University's 2026 GREAT Scholarships.
benefits: GBP 10,000 toward tuition fees, the minimum GREAT Scholarships award value
documents: Evidence of the overseas equivalent of a UK first-class honours degree, held or expected
Written consent to be contacted by the British Council
application_method: Apply for admission to an eligible one-year, on-campus postgraduate master's programme at the University of Edinburgh
Submit the GREAT Scholarships application by the published deadline, which has passed for the 2026 cycle
Await notification, which the University said would come by the end of June/start of July 2026
existing.selection_notes: The scholarship is awarded on the basis of academic merit. Candidates must have, or expect to obtain, the overseas equivalent of a UK first-class honours degree.
existing.duration: One year; single award applied toward tuition fees for a one-year on-campus postgraduate master's programme
existing.application_period: The 2026 cycle is closed and outcomes were due by the end of June/start of July 2026. The University of Edinburgh has announced that GREAT Scholarships 2027 award information and application instructions are coming soon.
existing.deadline_display: The deadline to apply for the 2026 scholarships has now passed; the University states that award information and application instructions for GREAT Scholarships 2027 are coming soon
existing.program_type: Partial tuition fee scholarship under the British Council GREAT Scholarships programme
